name: Product Gallery Slider, Variation Images, Video, Zoom & Lightbox for WooCommerce – Easy Product Gallery
author: themewant

sections.description:
All-in-One WooCommerce Product Gallery Plugin to Display Images & Videos Beautifully, Improve Shopping Experience, and Increase Sales Effortlessly. Want to improve your product page design and increase sales? Do you have multiple images to showcase your product? No problem! WooCommerce Product Gallery helps you turn the default WooCommerce product gallery into a beautiful and interactive image slider. Display your product and variation images in a clean, modern gallery layout that grabs customer attention and creates a better shopping experience.

Live Demo | Docs | Get Pro | Get Support

Why Use WooCommerce Product Gallery?:

  • Enable Additional Variation Images Gallery Slider
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design.
  • Customizable gallery layout.
  • Easy navigation with image zoom and lightbox support.
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.
  • Add Engaging Product Video Galleries
  • Powerful Image Zoom for Better Product Detail View
  • Smooth Lightbox Popup for Product Images
  • Image 360 Degree view

WooCommerce Product Gallery simplifies the process of enhancing your product pages with an engaging image gallery. Highlight product details with an interactive experience to boost customer confidence and sales. 🚀

✔ Product Variation Images Gallery:

With WooCommerce Product Gallery, you can add multiple images for each product variation. This allows customers to view different image sets whenever they switch between variations.

By default, WooCommerce only lets you assign a single image to each variation. This can be limiting when you want to display more product details or show different angles of a variation. Easy Product Gallery removes this limitation by allowing you to upload unlimited images for every variation. As customers select options like Color, Size, or Style, the gallery updates automatically to display the relevant images for that specific variation, creating a more informative and engaging shopping experience. 🚀

✔ Product Video Gallery:

Show product videos directly inside your product image gallery to create a more engaging shopping experience. Videos help customers understand your product better and can increase the chances of conversion.

Easy Product Gallery supports multiple video sources, including YouTube, Vimeo , Dailymotion, Facebook, and self-hosted videos. All supported video types can be smoothly embedded and played within the gallery alongside your product images. 🚀

✔ Product Image Zoom:

Enhance your WooCommerce store with advanced product image zoom functionality. Customers can easily hover to view magnified product details, helping them inspect textures, colors, and fine elements before purchase.

Choose from multiple zoom styles including standard, zoom window, and inner zoom. Customize lens shape, color, border, transparency, and zoom window settings to match your store design.

Improve user experience and boost conversions with a smooth, fully customizable product zoom feature. 🚀

✔ Product Image Lightbox:

Enable a smooth, distraction-free product viewing experience with a built-in lightbox. Customers can click to open images in a full-screen popup gallery and easily browse every detail.

This enhanced image view improves user engagement, helps shoppers better understand products, and can boost conversions on your WooCommerce store. 🚀

👉 Key Features

Modern Product Gallery Layouts
Select from a variety of stylish gallery layouts to display your product images in an attractive and organized way.
Flexible Thumbnail Positions
Display thumbnails in different positions to match your store design:
Thumbnails Left Live Demo
Thumbnails Bottom Live Demo
Thumbnails Top Live Demo
Thumbnails Right Live Demo
Thumbnail carousel two column Live Demo
Thumbnail Vertical Scroll Live Demo
Thumbnail 360 degree view Live Demo
Single product zoom view style Live Demo
Thumbnail different hosted video support Live Demo

🎬 Multiple Hosted Video Support

Showcase your products with video directly inside the gallery. Supports YouTube, Vimeo ,Dailymotion , and self-hosted video formats .

🔍 4 Zoom View Styles

Let customers explore your products in detail with four distinct zoom interaction styles — inner zoom, lens zoom, window zoom, and more.

🔄 Interactive Product Image Slider

Replace the default WooCommerce gallery with a smooth and responsive slider for better product viewing on all screen sizes.

📚 Live Preview & Helpful Documentation

Check live demos and follow detailed step-by-step guides to easily configure and customize your product gallery.

🛒 Product Gallery Slider – Complete Feature Overview

Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce

Attach unlimited videos to both simple and variable products directly inside the WooCommerce product gallery. Support for YouTube, Vimeo , Dailymotion , Facebook, and self-hosted videos helps customers explore every product detail through engaging video content — boosting buyer confidence and driving higher conversions.

Two Video Playback Modes

Choose between inline playback for quick in-page viewing or popup mode for an immersive fullscreen video experience. Customize the play icon size, color, background, autoplay, and looping settings to match your store design perfectly.

Responsive Product Image Thumbnail Slider

Replace the default WooCommerce product gallery with an advanced thumbnail slider. Customers can scroll through product images and variation images smoothly, with autoplay, infinite loop, and fully adjustable slide-per-view settings for a seamless shopping experience on all devices.

Product Image Slider with Navigation Controls

Give customers intuitive control over browsing product images and variations. Configure autoplay interval, slider speed, horizontal or vertical sliding direction, and mouse wheel navigation to create a smooth, interactive product browsing experience.

Multiple Image Transition Effects

Enhance your WooCommerce product image slider with eye-catching transition effects. Choose from Slide and Fade effects in the free version, with additional Flip, Cube, Coverflow , and Creative effects available.

  • Slide — Smooth horizontal or vertical sliding transition between product images
  • Fade — Elegant fade-in and fade-out transition for a clean image switch
  • Cube — 3D cube rotation effect for a dynamic product image transition
  • Flip — 3D card-flip animation between product gallery images
  • Creative — Unique creative transition animation for a standout gallery experience

Main Product & Thumbnail Slider Settings

  • Set slider image size, height, and width for product images
  • Choose slider transition effects (Slide, Fade)
  • Enable autoplay and infinite loop for continuous image sliding
  • Full RTL (Right-to-Left) language support
  • Free mode scrolling without snap for natural browsing
  • Adjust slider speed in milliseconds for precise control
  • Enable mouse wheel control for desktop users
  • Set overall slider size, padding, and margin
  • Enable main product image navigation arrows
  • Control thumbnail navigation visibility, color, hover color, and background
  • Set navigation icon size for optimal UX
  • Configure slides per view and slides gap
  • Enable slider pagination with Dot and Fraction styles
  • Customize pagination visibility, background, active background, and position

Video Placement Options in Product Gallery

Control exactly where product videos appear within the WooCommerce gallery slider. Position videos strategically to maximize customer engagement:

  • Top — Display videos above product images
  • Left — Show videos on the left side of the gallery
  • Bottom — Place videos below product images
  • Default — Use the standard gallery order

Product Video Gallery Features

  • Choose video play mode: Inline or Popup
  • Set play icon size, color, and hover color
  • Customize play icon background and hover background
  • Enable or disable video autoplay
  • Enable or disable video looping
  • Enable video preloader before playback starts

WooCommerce Product Image Zoom

Help customers inspect every product detail before purchasing with powerful image zoom functionality. Zoom builds buyer confidence, reduces return rates, and increases conversions — especially for products where texture, color accuracy, and fine details matter.

  • Enable or disable image zoom on WooCommerce product images
  • Standard zoom style included in free version

Product Image Lightbox with Fullscreen View

Let customers open product images in a distraction-free fullscreen lightbox popup. Navigate through the entire product image gallery smoothly for a premium viewing experience that keeps shoppers engaged.

  • Choose lightbox transition effect (e.g., Slide)
  • Set lightbox icon positions (Top Right, Top Left, Bottom Right, Bottom Left, Middle)
  • Enable or disable lightbox image captions
  • Show or hide image counter in the lightbox
  • Customize close icon color, hover color, background, and hover background

360 Degree Product View for WooCommerce

Allow customers to explore products from every angle with an interactive 360 degree image view popup. This immersive feature increases product engagement and purchase confidence by giving shoppers a complete visual understanding of the product.

  • Enable or disable the 360 degree product view popup
  • Set popup button position (Bottom Left)
  • Adjust bottom and left offset percentages for the popup button
  • Choose 360 degree gallery layout style
  • Configure navigation controls display in the popup
  • Set popup content width and height

🚀 PRO Features – Unlock the Full Power of WooCommerce Product Gallery

Upgrade to WooCommerce Product Gallery Pro to unlock advanced gallery layouts, premium slider effects, enhanced zoom controls, 360 degree drag interaction, and more. Take your WooCommerce product pages to the next level with professional-grade features designed to maximize sales and customer engagement.

5 Premium Product Gallery Layouts (Pro)

Go beyond the standard gallery slider with five stunning grid and carousel layouts designed to showcase your WooCommerce products beautifully:

  • Modern Grid One [PRO] — Live Demo
  • Modern Grid Two [PRO] — Live Demo
  • Modern Grid Three [PRO] — Live Demo
  • Modern Grid Four [PRO] — Live Demo
  • Layout Vertical Scroll [PRO] — Live Demo

Advanced Slider Transition Effects (Pro)

Make your product image slider stand out with premium transition effects that create a polished, professional presentation:

  • Flip [PRO] — 3D card-flip transition between product images
  • Coverflow [PRO] — Elegant coverflow-style sliding effect
  • Creative [PRO] — Unique creative transition animation

Premium Pagination Styles (Pro)

Enhance gallery navigation with advanced pagination designs for a better user experience:

  • Number Style [PRO] — Display numbered pagination for product images
  • Progressbar Style [PRO] — Show a visual progress bar as customers browse images
  • Dynamic Bullet [PRO] — Animated bullet pagination for modern gallery navigation

Advanced Product Image Zoom Controls (Pro)

Unlock three additional zoom styles and full customization over the zoom experience on your WooCommerce product pages:

  • Zoom Window [PRO] — Display a separate magnified window beside the product image
  • Zoom Lens [PRO] — Magnify through a movable lens directly on the image
  • Zoom Window Two [PRO] — Alternative zoom window layout for different store designs
  • Choose lens shape [PRO]: Round or Square [PRO]
  • Customize lens color, border width, border style (Solid, Dashed, Dotted, Double), and border color [PRO]
  • Adjust lens overlay opacity for perfect transparency [PRO]
  • Set zoom window size (height and width) [PRO]
  • Set zoom window background color and overlay opacity [PRO]
  • Adjust zoom window left distance from the main product image [PRO]
  • Customize zoom window border: width, style, and color [PRO]

Advanced 360 Degree Product View (Pro)

Take the 360 degree product view experience further with drag-to-rotate interaction, autoplay controls, and full customization for a truly immersive shopping experience:

  • Enable Drag to Rotate [PRO] — Let customers click and drag to spin the product
  • Adjustable drag speed and sensitivity[PRO]
  • 360 Degree AutoPlay [PRO] — Automatically rotate the product view
  • Configurable autoplay speed in milliseconds [PRO]
  • Additional button positions [PRO]: Bottom Right, Top Left, Top Right
  • Customize navigation icon color and hover color [PRO]
  • Set navigation background and hover background colors [PRO]

Advanced Product Video Controls (Pro)

Get full control over how product videos appear and behave in your WooCommerce gallery. The free version supports YouTube videos, while Pro unlocks support for multiple video platforms:

  • Dailymotion Video Support [PRO] — Embed Dailymotion product videos directly in your gallery
  • Self-Hosted Video Support [PRO] — Upload and play your own MP4/WebM videos within the gallery
  • Facebook Video Support [PRO] — Display Facebook-hosted product videos seamlessly

  • Vimeo Video Support [PRO] — Integrate Vimeo product videos for high-quality playback

  • Custom Video Aspect Ratio [PRO] — Set precise ratios like 16:9, 4:3, or any custom value

  • Video Player Controls [PRO] — Show or hide play, pause, volume, and progress controls
  • Mobile Video Playback [PRO] — Enable or disable video playback on mobile devices
  • Video Play Icon Position [PRO] — Place the play icon at Top Right, Top Left, Bottom Right, or Bottom Left

👉 Upgrade to Premium

If you like WooCommerce Product Gallery, then consider checking our other WordPress Plugins:

sections.installation:
1. Upload the themewant-product-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the WooCommerce product page to see the enhanced image gallery.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce Product Gallery compatible with my theme?

Yes, WooCommerce Product Gallery is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.

What does WooCommerce Product Gallery do?

Product Gallery slider replaces the default WooCommerce product gallery with a modern, responsive image slider that supports images, videos, zoom, lightbox, and variation image galleries to create a better shopping experience.

Can I add multiple images for each product variation?

Yes. Product Gallery Slider allows you to add unlimited images for each product variation such as color, size, or style. When customers switch variations, the gallery automatically updates to show the relevant images.

Which video sources are supported in the product gallery?

The plugin supports multiple video sources including YouTube, Vimeo (Pro), Dailymotion (Pro), Facebook (Pro), and self-hosted videos (Pro). Videos can be displayed alongside product images within the gallery.

Can I choose where product videos appear in the gallery?

Yes. You can control the position of product videos in the gallery slider. Supported positions include Top, Left, Bottom, or Default placement.

Does the plugin support product image zoom?

Yes. WooCommerce Image Gallery includes powerful zoom functionality that allows customers to inspect product details by hovering over images.

What Product zoom styles are available?

The plugin offers multiple zoom styles including: Standard Zoom, Zoom Window (Pro), Zoom Window Two (Pro), Zoom Lens (Pro). You can also customize the zoom lens appearance, overlay opacity, and zoom window settings.

Does the plugin include a lightbox feature?

Yes. The plugin includes a built-in lightbox popup that lets customers open product images in a larger view and navigate through them easily.

Can I customize the Product Slider lightbox design?

Yes. You can customize various lightbox options such as: Transition effects, Close icon color and background, Image captions, Image counter display, Icon positions

Can I customize the gallery layout?

Absolutely! The plugin offers multiple layout options that you can configure to match your store’s design.

Does it support Product image zoom and lightbox?

Yes, the gallery includes zoom and lightbox functionality for a seamless viewing experience.

Does the plugin support 360° product view?

Yes. You can display products in an interactive 360° image view popup, allowing customers to explore products from every angle.

Can I control the position of the 360° view button?

Yes. You can place the 360° popup button in different positions such as Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Left, or Bottom Right, and adjust the button offset as needed.
